_about: Gore carried over from MORDHAU. Skyrim decides who dies (one health pool); MORDHAU says where the blow landed and with what.

rows.rule: the blow that kills lands on the head and the player's MORDHAU weapon is one of these (blunt): the head is not drawn any more, and the race's own blood effects are played from the head in eight directions
rows.source: MORDHAU: blunt weapons crush heads (ExplodeLimbs / IsLastDismemberedBoneBluntForce); which weapons count is a list made here
rows.head_rule: play-test note, 2026-10-11. A killing blow takes the head (or crushes it) only when it is a headshot - the point of the blade's hit line nearest the body's upright middle line is no lower than 5 cm under the head bone (the base of the skull) - AND that point is within 12 cm of the middle line (the blade goes through the neck / head, not past its side). Before: the whole blade line within 30 cm of the head bone - and an ordinary hit on the torso took a head off. Never on a character Skyrim marks essential (cannot die): seen in play 2026-10-12, one lost his head and lived. 2026-10-13 (play-test note; MORDHAU's log: those blows passed 13-25 cm from the head bone at or above its height, but 20-48 cm): the middle line was the upright through the body's FEET (its mesh's own origin), and a fighter's head is rarely over that - it leans, and a free stand-in's body is moved against its origin. Now the line is the upright through the HEAD BONE itself: a headshot = some point of the blade's hit line no lower than 5 cm under the head bone, no higher than 35 cm over it, passes within 12 cm of that upright. Same night, 12 -> 20 cm: a Maul blow the player saw land on the head passed 16 cm from the head's upright (the hit line is the weapon's middle line, a maul's head is wide, and the line is read a frame or two after the blow, when the weapon has already stopped). The height condition still keeps blows at chest height out. 2026-10-13 : for the blunt weapons of this row the part does not apply - a killing blow at head height whose hit line passes within head_any_cm (30) of the head's upright crushes the head. Cutting a head off (head_comes_off) keeps the narrow rule (head_spine_cm).

rows.weapons: (every weapon not in head_explodes, except bare fists)
rows.rule: the blow that kills lands on the head and is a strike (not a stab) with a weapon that is not blunt: the head leaves the body, flies away from the player, falls and stays lying; the race's blood effects are played from the neck
rows.source: MORDHAU: cutting strikes take heads off, stabs do not; the flight is this plugin's own simple throw (no physics body)

rows.rule: MORDHAU's own gore meshes close the wound: GoreNeck on the neck of a body whose head was cut off and under the loose head; Gore1JuttedBone on the neck of a crushed head (sheets/props.json gore_neck, gore_stump)

blood builds up on whoever is hit (0.22 of full cover per ordinary blow, by the blow's strength) and a little on whoever hits (0.06); it shows on armour, skin and the weapon in the hand (the weapon more), darker and wetter than what is under it. On the player it fades over about four minutes; on others it stays.
rows.source: MORDHAU's blood on characters and weapons (MF_Blood / the weapons' blood masks); the amounts and the fade are choices made here, the pattern is MORDHAU's T_GrungeScratchBlood
